1418-2226-4713.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more artifacts.
1418-2226-4713.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
1418-2226-4713.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Virtue of Knowledge.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Lumengrid Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Lumengrid Drake enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

1981-2415-6720-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-6720-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

539-1462-3821-4679-8095.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-1462-3821-4679-8095.description:
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Repeat

710-6495-8207.easyPrerequisites: Ferocity of the Hunt attached to Danitha.
710-6495-8207.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
710-6495-8207.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2150-2281-3899.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Hero of the Dunes
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Hero of the Dunes
When Hero of the Dunes dies, Saffi triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1479-5621-7893.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2034-2043-5446-7824.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Esika's Chariot.
When the Esika's Chariots enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger, creating eight 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three tokens, adding six {C}.
Repeat.
2034-2043-5446-7824.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other artifact(s) with Urza's ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3259-5434-7795.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5434-7795.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Drider, triggering Breath of Fury and Drider.
Resolve the Drider trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

215-3443-4068.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
You have at least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
215-3443-4068.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding an amount of {B} or {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Deathbloom Ritualist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Deathbloom Ritualist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-3443-4068.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {B}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Deathbloom Ritualist

1624-4761-7439.description:
During your turn, activate Teferi, Time Raveler's first loyalty ability by putting a +1/+1 counter on them, allowing you to cast sorcery spells as though they had flash until your next turn
On the end step prior to your turn, cast a copy of Channel from exile by paying {G}{G}, unpreparing Yavimaya Bloomsage.
Activate Channel by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 until you have exactly 1 life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

1394-2034-2060-7038-7267.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Michelangelo.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Michelangelo.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

240-4359-5470-6798.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat from step 2.

4200-4605-7339.description:
Cast Go Ninja Go by paying its mana cost, blinking Icewind Stalwart.
Icewind Stalwart and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart trigger, blinking another permanent you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Icewind Stalwart that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Icewind Stalwart token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Icewind Stalwart.
Repeat from step 2.

1600-2302-5339.description: Because Sandwurm Convergence prevents creatures with flying from attacking you, and Teferi's Moat prevents creatures without flying from attacking you (as they're all the named color due to Painter's Servant), no creatures can attack you.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2034-2762-6705.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Frog creature token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Frog, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Thopter Squadron's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Thopter, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

512-527-4241.easyPrerequisites: Selvala and Halo Fountain do not have summoning sickness.
512-527-4241.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Halo Fountain to become a creature.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{W}{W}.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and Selvala, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
512-527-4241.notes: With the excess mana, you can use it on Halo Fountain's first ability, tapping and untapping it to create creature tokens.

457-5159-5491-6791.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Worldwalker Helm that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature with haste named Mishra's Warform, and a Map token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping a Map, adding {U}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it and a Map token for each Mishra's Warform and/or Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two Maps, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
457-5159-5491-6791.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

338-1818-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-1818-3197.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4067-5742-5743-6753.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

997-3055-6553.easyPrerequisites: Gift of Immortality attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
997-3055-6553.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1445-2292-4871-5632.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2292-4871-5632.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Chalk Outline triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3525-5115-5149-5516.easyPrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Red Death.
Power Artifact attached to Gemstone Array.
3525-5115-5149-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Red Death.
3525-5115-5149-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Gemstone Array by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

2538-2585-3682-5911.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one colored legendary creature or planeswalker.
You have no other cards in hand.
2538-2585-3682-5911.description:
Activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Mox Amber by paying its mana cost.
Flubs triggers, causing you to return Grim Monolith from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Grim Monolith by paying its mana cost.
Flubs triggers, causing you to return Mox Amber from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind.
Repeat.

359-372-4477.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Acrobatic Maneuver exiled by Abdel Adrian.
359-372-4477.description:
Cast Acrobatic Maneuver by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Greenwarden of Murasa and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Greenwarden of Murasa trigger.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Acrobatic Maneuver from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Acrobatic Maneuver.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Greenwarden of Murasa and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1115-3259-6096.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-3259-6096.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and General Kreat as attackers.
General Kreat triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, General Kreat triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
1115-3259-6096.notes: After the first loop, General Kreat doesn't have to attack, since the Goblin token attacking will trigger it.

1409-2933-4359-5798.easyPrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Drowner of Hope.
1409-2933-4359-5798.description:
Activate Drowner of Hope by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Drowner of Hope trigger, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Drowner of Hope.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2178-5231-5698.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Ulamog's Dreadsire.
Ulamog's Dreadsire does not have summoning sickness.
2178-5231-5698.description:
Activate Ulamog's Dreadsire by tapping it, creating a 10/10 Eldrazi creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Eldrazi token, adding {R}.
When the Eldrazi token dies, Ulamog's Dreadsire triggers, untapping Ulamog's Dreadsire.
Repeat.

215-3676-4050-4555-5176.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven Forests.
215-3676-4050-4555-5176.description:
Cast Tangle Golem by paying {0}.
Radagast and Tangleroot trigger.
Resolve the Tangleroot trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Radagast trigger, creating a 3/3 Beast creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Beast, adding {1}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Tangle Golem from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1331-1495-3129.notablePrerequisites:
Scythe of the Wretched attached to Triskelion.
Triskelion has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
1331-1495-3129.description:
If Triskelion has more than 3 +1/+1 counters on it, activate Trislekion by removing all additional counters to deal damage to your choice of targets.
Activate Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it to deal 1 damage to itself.
Repeat step 1 an additional 2 times, killing Triskelion.
Scythe of the Wretched triggers, returning Triskelion to the battlefield with Scythe of the Wretched attached to it.
Repeat.

147-5067.easyPrerequisites: There is at least one nonland permanent on the battlefield.
147-5067.description:
Cast Release to the Wind by paying {2}{U}
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Release to the Wind, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Release to the Wind copy, exiling Dualcaster Mage
Cast Dualcaster Mage from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.
